signals.name: US 10Y yield (ZN inverse)
signals.label: Trend pullback (RSI-2)
signals.entry_txt: Next session open (or limit 0.25 ATR better).
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.5 ATR, target 1.5 ATR, time-stop 7 sessions.
signals.why: Short-term mean reversion inside a long-term trend (Connors RSI-2; short-horizon reversal documented by Jegadeesh 1990 / Lehmann 1990). You buy fear inside an up-trend.
reasons: Price above 200-day average (4.9180 vs 4.6065) -> long-term trend is up
12-month momentum +19.8% confirms the trend
RSI(2) = 9.0 -> short-term oversold (trigger <10)

Out-of-sample (last 30% of trades): +0.11R per trade
signals.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if price trades below 4.7972 (=-1R) or nothing happens by 2026-12-02.

signals.name: AUD/USD
signals.label: Failed breakout (rejection)
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.25 ATR (beyond the rejection wick), target 2 ATR, time-stop 5 sessions.
signals.why: Liquidity grab / stop-run: price trades through a 20-day extreme, finds no follow-through and closes back inside the range -> trapped breakout traders fuel the reversal.
reasons: Swept the prior 20-day low 0.66358 intraday
...but closed back inside the range with IBS 0.71 (strong rejection)
History on AUD/USD: 176 trades, hit 47% (95% CI 40-55%), avg +0.02R net of costs

Data caveat: Large open-vs-previous-close gaps (median 0.48x avg range): feed mixes sessions or futures rolls -> backtest fills are less reliable
